name: @qf-jarvis/agent-runtime
description: QF Jarvis authority-first agent and conversation runtime foundation (QFJ-M1). Deterministic, provider-neutral runtime contracts for the future WhatsApp coordinator: a closed actor/party/channel vocabulary, strict agent assignment (Riya=client-only, Anisha=vendor-only, Jarvis=coordination), a validated conversation-state machine with human-takeover/AI-pause gates, a content-minimized inbound envelope, and proposal-only decisions that always remain PENDING_CORE_VALIDATION. No transport/provider/database/n8n coupling; no WhatsApp API, no dashboard UI, no persistence, no live model call, no real message data. QuickFurno Core remains final authority. Depends only on zod.
